vfx_design.purpose: Reliquary aura communicates current gameplay read: ember breathing in Reading, gold alignment in SafeWindow, red pressure in Hostile, blue cooling in Success.
vfx_design.shape_language: Concentric ember orbit, vertical ash lift, ring-alignment pulse, hostile compression flare.
vfx_design.spawn_behavior: CPU sprite system with state-driven user parameters consumed by runtime component; low bounded density for calibration scene.
vfx_design.motion: Slow lift and orbit for Reading; synchronized ring pulse for SafeWindow; sharp strobing/pressure for Hostile; low drift for Cooled.
vfx_design.energy: StateColor, State, SpawnRate, Energy, and Pulse driven by AFoundryRelicActor.
vfx_design.timing: 2s read, 3s safe window, 1.5s hostile loop; instant attune success/failure feedback.
vfx_design.color: Reading ember umber, SafeWindow gold, Hostile hot red, Success cooled cyan.
vfx_design.dissipation: Small upward fade, no screen-filling bursts.
vfx_design.lighting_interaction: Point light mirrors Niagara state for gameplay-readable glow.
vfx_design.screen_space_density: Three relics remain readable at third-person camera distance without hiding HUD or player.
vfx_design.performance_budget: CPU Niagara, <=3 active systems, <=100 nominal spawned particles per relic per second.

audio_design.architecture: Imported generated SoundWave cues, played spatially at reliquary location on state transition and interaction outcome.
audio_design.ambient_world_sound: Deferred to later slice pass; not claimed yet.
audio_design.idle_state: Visual pulse only for now, avoids repetitive audio fatigue.
audio_design.state_transition_feedback: SafeWindow and Hostile cues play once per transition.
audio_design.danger_feedback: Hostile cue plus red light/VFX state.
